conflict_report: TOP view shows the tail laid straight back with the stinger pointing backwards; 3/4, FRONT, BACK, LEFT and RIGHT views all show the tail curled up and forward over the body with the stinger hanging down/forward. One rigid model cannot satisfy both. Policy: 5 of 6 views win (tail curled). TOP view is used only for the body footprint, leg splay angles and claw spread.
surface_rules: Rock blocks: charcoal/dark-brown with square Roblox studs (TEXTURE, not geometry) and glowing lava seams on every block edge
Body plates: extra glowing crack lines
Claw fingers, stinger, leg tips: studded gradient deep red -> lava orange -> hot yellow toward the tip
Eyes: two glowing yellow-orange slits low on the head front
